sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with C.T. Case No. 63 of 2022, pending in the Court of the learned J.M.F.C-1 (Cog. Taking), Baripada, arising out of Bangriposi P.S. Case No.263 of 2022 for commission of alleged offences under Sections 376(2)(n)/323/294 of IPC read with Section 66(E)/67(A) of I.T. Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Baripada, by order dated 21.12.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. It is submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 06.12.2022 and as charge sheet has been filed on 30.01.2023, further continuance of the petitioner in custody is not warranted.
5. Copy of the charge sheet filed by the learned counsel for the petitioner is taken on record.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

7. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.
8.
Considering the tenor thereof and taking into account the filing of charge sheet and period of Prasanta Kumar Singh vs State Of Odisha ....
